method.independentOracle: Python Fraction and Decimal formulas with no production-module imports
method.transport: newline-delimited JSON text to a separate Node 22 process
method.comparisonDefinition: One exact structured comparison covers the complete selected result or exact error name and code for one production invocation.
method.combinedCommand: cd venue && python3 oracle/state/independent/verify.py && python3 -O oracle/state/independent/verify.py
method.makeTargetReason: A target would pretend the intentionally ignored harness exists in a clean checkout.

nonDefectObservations.observation: Auction print conversion floors the exact rational USD8 value. It does not round a half unit upward.
Market arithmetic rounds an exact half upward after summing all price times volume products.
Deviation is asymmetric because the fallback value is the denominator, and integer division floors before the strict greater-than threshold check.
A valuation exactly on a coupon date excludes that paid cashflow and resets accrued interest for the next future period.
Dealer source identifiers are deduplicated before fallback quorum. A later quote with the same identifier replaces the earlier value without adding a source.
A zero settlement is rejected as ambiguous before the configured minimum-volume comparison, including when the configured minimum is zero.

Source qualification requires settled volume to equal indicated crossed volume. Lower volume is partial, higher volume is an indicated-volume mismatch, and only an exact match reaches the minimum-volume check.

notTestedOrUncovered: Live NY Fed, Mirror Node, JSON-RPC, Hedera 0x168, dealer signature, and HCS retrieval paths were not called.
The quote-engine orchestration and publisher transaction path were not run end to end.
Counterparty identity, wash-trade, excluded-address, malformed log, and digest correctness were not reverified except where needed to reach numeric qualification.
JavaScript Number behavior above the safe integer range was not treated as supported for timestamps, age limits, or coupon counts. Large integer monetary inputs were transported as decimal text.
Arbitrary schedule lengths and every uint256 value were not exhaustively enumerated. The corpus uses constructed boundaries and Cartesian configuration sweeps.
Resource exhaustion from extremely long schedules, extremely long decimal strings, or unbounded BigInt growth was not measured.
No independent external bond-pricing library was used. The oracle is a Python Fraction derivation of the stated discrete cashflow rules.
No Makefile target was added because the ignored harness is intentionally absent from a clean checkout.

circularityRisks: The production implementation and this corpus were interpreted from the same repository requirements, so a shared specification misunderstanding remains possible.
The Node bridge imports production modules and selects numeric output fields. A bridge selection mistake could hide an unselected field defect.
The Python model uses a different Fraction product derivation, but it intentionally reproduces the same coupon and cashflow floor points required by the interface.
The corpus is deterministic and constructed. This improves branch targeting but does not provide probabilistic exploration outside the listed Cartesian sets.
Normal and optimized runs use the same Python and Node versions on the same machine.
Tracked unit tests were not used as expected-value oracles.
